core_principles: High contrast, bold borders, and hard offset shadows
Flat neon accents in both light and dark modes

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase font-heading
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-black tracking-tight uppercase font-heading

typography.rules: All headings must use Bricolage Grotesque. Labels, buttons, and category pills MUST be UPPERCASE. Use Work Sans for readable body content.

Button.base: font-bold uppercase tracking-wide border-[3px] border-brutal-border bg-brutal-surface text-brutal-text shadow-brutal rounded-brutal transition-all duration-150 px-6 py-3 cursor-pointer
Button.primary: bg-brutal-yellow text-black border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#000] dark:border-[#FAFAF5] dark:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#FAFAF5]

Card_Panel.base: border-[3px] border-brutal-border bg-brutal-surface shadow-brutal-lg p-6 rounded-brutal

Input.base: border-[3px] border-brutal-border bg-brutal-bg text-brutal-text p-3 rounded-brutal focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 shadow-brutal transition-all duration-150

FilterPill.base: font-bold uppercase text-sm border-[3px] border-brutal-border bg-brutal-surface text-brutal-text px-4 py-2 rounded-brutal shadow-brutal transition-colors duration-200 cursor-pointer
FilterPill.active: bg-brutal-cyan text-black border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#000] dark:border-[#FAFAF5] dark:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#FAFAF5]

Header.base: border-b-[4px] border-brutal-border bg-brutal-bg py-4 px-6 flex items-center justify-between z-50 fixed top-0 w-full
Header.theme_toggle: p-2 border-[3px] border-brutal-border bg-brutal-surface shadow-[2px_2px_0px_var(--shadow-color)] active:translate-x-[1px] active:translate-y-[1px] active:shadow-[1px_1px_0px_var(--shadow-color)] rounded-brutal cursor-pointer

BottomNav.base: fixed bottom-0 w-full border-t-[4px] border-brutal-border bg-brutal-surface shadow-brutal-top z-40 flex justify-around p-4

SlideUpWizard.container: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 max-h-[90vh] bg-brutal-surface border-t-[4px] border-brutal-border shadow-brutal-panel p-6 overflow-y-auto transform transition-transform duration-300 ease-out z-50 rounded-t-brutal

map_features.user_pulse_animation: @keyframes pulse { 0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: scale(2); opacity: 0; } } Apply this to a ::after element on the user marker.

animations.tactile_press: Use translate-x/y and reduce shadow offset. Standard duration: 150ms.
animations.theme_crossfade: html.theme-transition, html.theme-transition *, html.theme-transition *:before, html.theme-transition *:after { transition: background-color 300ms ease, color 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease !important; transition-delay: 0 !important; }
animations.pin_bounce_in: @keyframes bounceIn { 0% { transform: scale(0); } 50% { transform: scale(1.2); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } } Apply with 300ms duration on map load.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply neo-brutalism purely as a visual layer. DO NOT change existing functionality, navigation, menus, or IA flows.
For Dark/Light theme, add a toggle (sun/moon icon) in the header. Use a data-theme attribute on the html tag and persist in localStorage.
Inject the theme-transition class to body/html for 300ms during toggling to achieve the crossfade, then remove it to avoid breaking other transitions.
Implement first-load location permission via native geolocation. Center map on user if allowed; gracefully fallback if denied.
Map markers must exclusively use the specified emojis. They must be tappable on mobile and legible in both themes.
Ensure standard components (buttons, inputs, cards) strictly follow the thick border (3-4px) and hard shadow tokens from the tailwind config.
Never use generic rounding above 4px and absolutely NO soft drop shadows (blur must be 0px).
Use Bricolage Grotesque for all headings, Work Sans for body.
Replace Shadcn components with raw HTML + Tailwind classes if they clash too heavily with the brutalist shapes, or heavily override their classes.
Ensure WCAG AA contrast in both themes. DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, panels, or floating elements.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all) globally in a way that breaks transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use the neo-brutalist button styles with tactile interaction animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use sonner for toasts, but override its styles to match the neo-brutalist theme (thick borders, hard shadows).
